snippet.title: Astropods: Starside Glaze Trailer!
snippet.description:
Astropods: Starside Glaze is an energetic 2D Fighting Platformer! Experience freeform movement, engaging combat with knockback, and badge upgrades that redefine playstyles. How will you mold your limitless potential to bring back the missing Waterfall of Dreams?

Steam demo link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3308340/Astropods_Starside_Glaze_Demo/
Itch.io link: https://cheesimoon.itch.io/astropodsstarsideglaze
